definition_zh: 至福的；安详喜悦的；天使般的
definition_en: showing or expressing complete calm happiness, as if blessed
core_image: 老人闭眼微笑，脸上带着天堂般的安详
scene: 午后的阳光下，她合上书，露出安详的微笑。She wore a beatific smile as the sunlight warmed her face.
sceneCN: 这里 beatific 是「至福安详的」（第 1 个义项：如受祝福般宁静喜悦的神情）；句意是阳光下她露出天使般的微笑。

derivatives.zh: 由 beatific 同根的动词，义为「宣福；（使）极乐」
同根名词，义为「至福；真福八端」
由 beatify 加 -tion 构成，义为「宣福礼」

senses.title: Showing calm, blessed happiness
senses.definition: showing complete calm and happiness, as if blessed from heaven
senses.definitionCN: 表现出全然的宁静与喜悦，仿佛受上天祝福
senses.example: She wore a beatific smile as the sunlight warmed her face.
senses.exampleCN: 阳光暖着她的脸，她露出安详的微笑。
senses.why: The core image is a saint's face at peace, so any deeply contented look earns the word.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是圣徒安息的面容，故任何深度满足的神情都可以用这个词。

senses.title: Conferring supreme blessedness
senses.definition: relating to the highest happiness of heaven, especially the beatific vision
senses.definitionCN: 与天国的至高幸福相关，尤指「荣福直观」
senses.example: Theologians describe the beatific vision as seeing God directly.
senses.exampleCN: 神学家把荣福直观描述为直接得见上帝。
senses.why: The theological sense keeps the original Latin idea of perfect blessedness.
senses.whyCN: 神学义保留了拉丁语中「完满之福」的本义。

intro.en: Beatific comes straight from Latin words for blessed happiness.
intro.cn: beatific 直接源自拉丁语中表示「有福」的词。

items.en: beatus meant blessed or happy, from beare, to make happy.
items.cn: 拉丁语 beatus 意为「有福的、幸福的」，动词 beare 意为「使幸福」。
中世纪拉丁语 beatificus 形容天国之福。

items.en: the word passed through French beatifique.
items.cn: 该词经法语 beatifique 传入。

items.en: beatific entered English in theological writing.
items.cn: 十七世纪 beatific 随神学著作进入英语。

items.en: beatific now also describes any serene, blissful look.
items.cn: 如今 beatific 也可形容任何宁静幸福的神态。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the beati- spelling or the -fic ending; the near-meaning group gathers words for serene joy.
note.cn: 形近组共享 beati- 拼写或 -fic 词尾；近义组汇集表示宁静喜悦的词。

entries.definition: to declare a person blessed; to make very happy
entries.definitionCN: 宣福；使极乐——与 beatific 同根的动词形式

entries.definition: supreme blessedness; a statement of blessing in the Sermon on the Mount
entries.definitionCN: 至福；真福八端——同根名词
可怕的；只是 -fic 词尾相同，词义几乎相反
圣洁的；共享圣徒般安详的联想

normalIntro.en: Beatific shares its root with beatify and beatitude.

normal.en: The root beatus means blessed in Latin.
normal.cn: 词根 beatus 在拉丁语中意为「有福的」。

normal.en: A beatific smile is calm and glowing.
normal.cn: beatific smile 指安详而发光的微笑。

normal.en: Beatific vision is a theology term.
normal.cn: beatific vision 是神学术语「荣福直观」。

normal.en: Beatify is the verb of the family.

abstract.en: See a monk's face at rest in warm light.
abstract.cn: 想象暖光中僧侣安息的面容。

abstract.en: Feel the hush after a long worry lifts.
abstract.cn: 感受长久忧虑散去后的静谧。

abstract.en: Picture heaven's peace resting on a smile.
abstract.cn: 想象天国的安宁落在一个微笑上。

examples.en: She wore a beatific smile as the sunlight warmed her face.
examples.cn: 阳光暖着她的脸，她露出安详的微笑。

examples.en: After the meditation he looked beatific.
examples.cn: 冥想之后他神情至福安详。

examples.en: Theologians describe the beatific vision as seeing God directly.
examples.cn: 神学家把荣福直观描述为直接得见上帝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「庇·阿提福」——上苍庇佑、提前赐福，脸上自然是一副至福安详的表情。

root: 源自拉丁语 beatus（有福的、幸福的），由动词 beare（使幸福）派生；经中世纪拉丁语 beatificus 与法语 beatifique 于十七世纪进入英语，先用于神学，后泛指安详至福的神情。

sensesIntro.en: From heaven's perfect blessing to any face at serene peace.
sensesIntro.cn: 从天国的完满之福，延伸到任何安详宁静的面容。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face at peace, lit as if blessed from above.
core.cn: 核心意象：仿佛受上天祝福般安详发光的脸。

intro.en: The family grows on beatus, adding -fy, -ion and -ic.
intro.cn: 词族以 beatus 为核心，加 -fy、-ion、-ic 等后缀。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin beatus, from beare, to make happy.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 beatus，来自 beare「使幸福」。

items.meaning: to declare blessed or to make happy
the act of declaring someone blessed
a blessing, especially at the end of a service
one who does good for others

derivatives.zh: 由 beatific 同根的动词，义为「宣福；（使）极乐」
同根名词，义为「至福；真福八端」
由 beatific 加 -ally 构成，义为「安详至福地」
